meta.title: Brisolo — Your menu. Smarter.
meta.description: Guests scan a QR code on the table and read your menu in their own language, with an explanation of every dish. Upload your menu once, AI translates, you check. From €29 a month.

hero.title: Your menu, in every guest's language.
hero.subtitle: Guests scan the QR code on the table and read your menu in their own language — with an explanation of every dish. No app needed. You upload your menu once, we do the rest.
hero.note: Free pilot for the first restaurants in Leuven.

problem.title: Your menu is perfect. Half your guests just can't read it.

items.title: Tourists guess
items.text: What's stoofvlees? Or waterzooi? Guests order what they recognise — and skip your best dishes.

items.title: Your staff translate
items.text: Every table asks the same questions. Time your team doesn't have during a busy service.

items.title: Allergies are a risk
items.text: A misunderstanding about nuts or gluten happens fast when guest and waiter don't share a language.

items.title: Menus in four languages
items.text: Every price change means translating and printing again. And the Spanish menu is always out of date.

how.title: Live in three steps. Usually within the hour.

steps.title: Upload your menu
steps.text: A photo of your menu, a PDF or a link to your website. That's all we need.

steps.title: AI translates, you check
steps.text: We structure and translate your menu. You check prices, dishes and allergens before it goes live.

steps.title: Put the QR code on the table
steps.text: Print the QR code and you're done. Change a price or run out of a dish? Guests see it instantly.

features.title: Built for your guests. And for you, mid-service.

items.title: The menu in their language
items.text: Automatically in their phone's language. English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Chinese and more.

items.title: An explanation of every dish
items.text: What's in it, how is it made? Including typical Belgian classics.

items.title: Photos of your dishes
items.text: Show what arrives on the plate. Photos are optional — your menu looks complete without them.

items.title: A cart to show the waiter
items.text: Guests collect what they want and show a clear screen with the original dish names.

items.title: Questions about the menu
items.text: “What's vegetarian?” — answers based only on your menu, never made up.

items.title: Sold out? One tap.
items.text: In Service mode you mark a dish as out of stock. Guests see it immediately.

items.title: Edit without the hassle
items.text: Change a price, add a dish, drag to reorder. Everything is saved and translated automatically.

items.title: Photos with your phone
items.text: Snap the plate and add it straight to the dish.

items.title: See what guests want
items.text: Which languages, which dishes get viewed, which questions get asked.

items.title: In your restaurant's style
items.text: Your colours, fonts and logo. Your menu feels like your restaurant, not a template.

items.title: Dish names as on your menu
items.text: “Stoofvlees met frietjes” stays “Stoofvlees met frietjes”. The translation sits underneath, never in its place.

items.title: Allergens only after you confirm
items.text: AI suggests allergens, you confirm them. Not confirmed yet? We ask the guest to check with staff.

items.title: EU hosting, GDPR
items.text: Your data stays in the EU. No cookies and no personal data from your guests.

items.title: No app for guests
items.text: Scan with the camera, read in the browser. Works on any smartphone.

pricing.title: Pay for your size. Everything included.
pricing.pilot: Free pilot for the first restaurants in Leuven.
pricing.intro: Choose your plan by the number of seats in your restaurant. Every plan has every feature.
pricing.sizeNote: You choose your plan by the number of seats. Is your menu opened much more than your plan expects (about {small} menu visits a month for Small, {medium} for Medium) two months in a row? Then we'll suggest the next plan. We never change your plan or your bill without asking.

items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: Usually less than an hour. You upload your menu, we structure and translate it, and you check everything. During the demo we put your first menu online together.

items.q: Which languages can guests read the menu in?
items.a: English, French, Dutch and German by default. You can add more, such as Spanish, Italian, Chinese or Japanese. If a guest picks a language that isn't translated yet, we translate it on the spot.
Change a price or dish in your dashboard and it's live immediately, in every language. Nothing to reprint — the QR code stays the same.

items.q: What about allergens and the law?
items.a: EU rules require you to provide information on the 14 allergens. Our AI suggests allergens for each dish, but guests only see them as fact once you've confirmed them. The bottom of the menu always says: “For allergies, please inform staff before ordering.”

That depends on your number of seats: Small up to 40, Medium 40 to 100, Large more than 100. Every plan has every feature. If your menu is opened much more than your plan expects two months in a row, we'll suggest the next plan; we never change it without asking.
Yes. The monthly plan can be cancelled any month, with no notice period. The annual plan runs until the end of the year.

items.q: Do guests need to install an app?
items.a: No. They scan the QR code with their camera and the menu opens in the browser. No account, no app.
